materials.note: 限定/非限定从句对照句组（语料派生，G1 命题覆盖）

content.title: 传感器对照句
content.text: The sensor that was tested indoors works well. The sensor, which was tested indoors, works well.

content.title: 投影仪两
content.text: A. The projector, which we borrowed from the media lab, stopped working during the exhibition. B. The projector stopped working during the exhibition, which meant that we had to change the installation.

materials.note: but/although 对照短文（G3 命题覆盖）

content.title: 排练记录
content.text: Our team built two ways to control an interactive artwork. Visitors could move their hands, or they could give voice commands. The voice prototype that worked well in a quiet studio failed during a crowded exhibition, where several groups were speaking at once. We kept the gesture controls, but we delayed voice control until we could test it with visitors in the exhibition hall.

content.title: 放映与配音
content.text: The film that impressed us in the small screening room was hard to follow in the noisy lobby. We kept the visual sequence but postponed the voice-over test.

materials.note: 话语标记组织短篇（G4 命题覆盖）

content.title: 博物馆地图
content.text: We made a map that tells visitors which rooms in the museum are busy. We expected people to choose a quieter route. In fact, some visitors walked toward the crowded rooms because they thought something interesting was happening there. The map was working as designed, but our assumption about what visitors wanted was incomplete.
